date_quality_policy: The placeholder-looking source date 1111-11-11 and dates beyond the snapshot label are preserved but withheld from incorporation trends, date filters and age scoring. No corrected date is inferred.

locations.policy: Postal district looked up from source state/PIN only. ROC and PIN filters use the original structured company fields. No address parsing or ROC-to-city inference. Missing, ambiguous or state-mismatched postal mappings remain Not identified. Districts are not municipal cities.

reference.author: Deepak Kumar
reference.reference_date: Package published 2026-03-16; underlying postal record date is not specified.
reference.notice: Third-party postal reference. District labels are not municipal city boundaries. Ambiguous state/PIN pairs are withheld.

area_reference.name: india-pincode-search
area_reference.author: Mayank Jhawar
area_reference.reference_date: Package published 2023-03-01; underlying postal record date unspecified.
area_reference.notice: Source village field is a representative PIN postal-area label, not a verified municipal city or exact company location. Conflicting labels and unresolved districts withheld.

active_listed_financials.note: Source master status is not evidence of current exchange trading status. Each reporting basis is explicit; financial years may differ. Missing values are blank, never zero-filled.

web_revenue_research.method: Screener: unique normalized legal-name candidate with source NSE symbol checked; master CIN not confirmed. Tofler: primary public-profile CIN matches master, but the revenue range is not independently verified. Cached Screener annual tables and freely displayed, dated Tofler revenue ranges were read; no general web search results were retrieved. Search links are research suggestions, not evidence.

direct_profiles.tofler: Repeated HTTP 503 service barriers; stopped after four dated public ranges

provider_access.note: Provider barriers are not evidence that a company has no revenue or no public financial information.
